checks.graphs: Finite heads and finite individual losses/total required. Combined P/foreground/G/I backward and separate C backward use the reviewed float64 gradient guard with prospective norm1, followed by clearing parameter gradients. Full model-state hash is compared with initialization; no optimizer or weight update exists.
checks.ownership: A global locked WeakKeyDictionary now claims each parser object once for its lifetime. Concurrent second owners, replacements after failure, and parsers with pre-existing gradients are refused. The diagnostic-level nonblocking lock still protects each public operation.
checks.failure: A fatal processing error latches stopped; failed backward/admission clears gradients in finally. A rejected racing constructor leaves the current owner's gradients untouched. Failure does not promise rollback of already advanced private tracking/history; the stopped owner cannot continue.
checks.scope: The helper itself cannot attest archive provenance, exact sample population or prescribed initialization. Those remain requirements for the separately reviewed, committed prospective runner before any native-archive model inference.

limitations: Technical synthetic source review only; not a preflight receipt for the separate runner and not permission to infer on real native archives.

A finite, nonzero or clipped gradient does not demonstrate useful supervision, stable learning, control identification or improved performance. Unit loss coefficients and norm1 are prospective numerical diagnostics, not a frozen training recipe.
Ownership is enforced for the same parser object, not as memory isolation. External code and distinct models aliasing parameter storage remain explicitly forbidden by the caller contract.

Recorded indices, operation IDs, source epochs and RGB provenance are supplied by the caller. The later sealed runner must bind them to the reviewed72 ordinary records and six paid pairs; this helper alone does not certify them.
Identity uses exactly eight delivered ordinary frames within a clip. Reusing a captured source anchor does not create a new paid observation, and gaps never imply fabricated intermediate targets.

Private temporal memory may already have advanced before a late fatal error. No rollback or resumption is claimed; failure must be preserved and the diagnostic/model cannot be repurposed through another owner.
No native wiring, full archival inference, calibration, throughput, optimization step, training, transfer or gate result follows from this receipt.
